zara: publish blocked by release-gate after a typegen regen on sample-app. I only reran the generator in CI container. Semver heuristic flagged a signature change (param order). Anyone else seen CI locale/container diffs cause this? :thinking:
ken: seen it. Docker image on CI had LANG unset so JSON map iteration ended up different across runs.
hao: can you paste the diff?
zara: snippet: ```diff
- func DeleteProject(ctx context.Context, id string, opts DeleteOpts) error
+ func DeleteProject(ctx context.Context, opts DeleteOpts, id string) error
```
darya: that's a pure parameter reorder. changelog logic treats any signature diff as breaking which tripped the gate. We should special-case reorder-only diffs.
regen-bot: regen-report: file: internal/api/projects.gen.go, changes: 1, classification: signature-diff, release-gate: BLOCKED
ci-bot: pipeline log: "typegen-check failed (exit 3) - regen diffs detected". Full run: `docker run --rm -e LANG=C ... make typegen`
ken: temporary fix: run `make typegen` in the same container image as CI, commit regenerated files. Long-term: either make generator deterministic independent of locale or add a reproducible seed.
hao: suggestion: add `--stable-seed` flag to typegen that builds sort keys using a deterministic salt when metadata missing. That would eliminate dependency on LANG/locale.
darya: also update changelog-generator to treat "reorder-only" as non-breaking. we can detect reorder-only by comparing sets of parameters and types rather than ordering.
zara: I ran a local reproduce with CI image: `docker run --entrypoint /bin/sh ci-image -c "make typegen && git status --porcelain"` -> showed diff. After running `make typegen --stable-seed=42`, diff cleared.
regen-bot: re-run suggestion: use stable-seed; re-evaluate: potential-semver: 0, release-gate: PASS
ken: will PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/512 adds `--stable-seed` and a test matrix across locales (C, en_US.UTF-8, zh_CN.UTF-8).
darya: opened changelog PR to classify reorder-only as non-semver: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/77. It adds an algorithm: if parameter sets and types are equal, mark as reorder-only.
hao: separate note: we had a flaky auth/retry integration test in go-sdk that might be caused by nondet map iteration used when building headers. i'll add a deterministic header ordering in tests to reduce false parity failures.
zara: after applying `--stable-seed` locally and updating changelog heuristics, CI re-run passed and publish proceeded. Thanks all! :tada:
ken: follow-up: schedule a nightly job that runs typegen in multiple locales to catch regressions. I'll add an entry to the devex board.
darya: closing this thread but keeping the PRs linked for review.
regen-bot: note: seed-based determinism default will be enabled in next typegen minor release."
